raw_text: A viral satellite image claiming to show a newly constructed Chinese military base inside Indian-controlled Ladakh has been exposed as a synthetic fabrication. Multiple geospatial intelligence firms confirmed no such structures exist at the claimed coordinates. The incident highlights growing concerns about AI-generated satellite imagery being used as a tool in information warfare between rival nations.
clean_text: Viral satellite image of Chinese base in Ladakh exposed as synthetic fabrication. Multiple geospatial firms confirm no structures at claimed coordinates. Highlights AI-generated imagery in information warfare.
